newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Weather-Occasional showers seen over Sri Lanka.
newsitem.headline: Weather-Occasional showers seen over Sri Lanka.

text.p: Sri Lanka's metereological department released the following rainfall figures for 24 hours ending Sunday morning

The department said occasional showers will be experienced in the Western, Central, Sabaragamuwa and Southern provinces on Monday. Gusts of fairly strong westerly winds are likely over the western slopes of the central hills and over the western and southern parts of the country.
Seas off the southwestern coast will experience occasional showers or thundershowers. Fairly strong westerly winds are also expected during showers.
